blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Behind closed doors, in an air conditioned bedroom where an 11-year-old boy fell asleep during a family visit, a quiet violation eventually haunted him. Overwhelmed by fear of an older relative, the little boy complied when his 25-year-old paternal aunt ordered him to undress. He remained silent at first—bound by youth, curiosity, and fear—only to carry a crushing weight of guilt and shame afterward. The silent trauma eventually turned into panic attacks, flashbacks, nightmares, and attempts to end his life. His case became the Supreme Court’s (SC) basis for declaring that sexual violence inflicts equal devastation regardless of […]...
